assert (D/'completion.json').exists()
load=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text())
def save(n,v): (P/n).write_text(json.dumps(v,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
wins=load(D/'windows.json');originals={};rows=[]

def esc(s):return s.replace('|','\\|').replace('\n',' ')
def excerpt(s):return s if len(s)<220 else s[:220]+'… [full output in JSON]'
lines=['# Recording 15: additional repetition audit','','Recording: 20261014-0801. Computational comparison completed; difficult speech remains unresolved. No manual audio listening claimed.','','## Method and limitations','','- Two English controls (00:00–00:15 and 00:20–00:35) and eight 15-second anomaly windows (00:51:20–00:53:20), each run with independent OpenAI Whisper small and Qwen short-window sensitivity check. The second Qwen run is not an independent architecture.','- Models run sequentially, CPU two threads, 16 kHz mono float32 decoded input without normalization, automatic language detection, greedy generation capped at 96 new tokens. Source/model hashes and complete raw outputs are preserved. The cap is computational control, not evidence of quality.','- Original 1024-token long-window and split-check failures remain unchanged in raw_asr. Do not treat model-only Chinese conversation, numbers, isolated words or long loops as verified speech.','- No-speech diagnostic uses the correct Whisper <|nocaptions|> token. Neither that score, RMS nor empty output establishes silence. Clear-English success does not validate difficult-window wording.','','## Findings', '', '- Of ten windows, Whisper has four possible generation-cap outputs and Qwen has one capped output; all are in the eight-window anomaly region. Shortening the window does not reliably recover its words.', '- The initial English control corroborates “two open questions” but Whisper omits preceding speech. The added 00:20–00:35 control broadly matches the closed-book-exam explanation; Whisper misrecognizes test sheets as best sheets. These are imperfect positive controls, not an accuracy certificate.', '- In the anomaly interval Qwen produces Chinese guesses including school-related wording, while Whisper produces unrelated syllabic loops, Khmer-script output, or unrelated Russian/English guesses. No new private-looking detail or long repetition is independently confirmed; neither model output is promoted to speech.', '', '## Window comparison','','| Interval | Original main output excerpt | Qwen short output | Independent Whisper output | Judgment |','|---|---|---|---|---|']
for w in wins:
 results={m:load(D/m/(w['id']+'.json')) for m in ['qwen-short','whisper']};paths=[]
 for f in sorted((B/'asr_rerun/results'/rid/'raw_chunks').glob('*.json')):
  v=load(f)
  if v['start_seconds']<w['end_seconds'] and v['end_seconds']>w['start_seconds']:
   p='raw_asr/recovery_20261018/'+rid+'/'+str(f.relative_to(B/'asr_rerun/results'/rid));originals[p]=v;paths.append(p)
 if w['start_seconds'] in [0,20]:judgment='Clear-English positive control; assess lexical accuracy separately from anomaly performance.'

 else:judgment='No reliable independent confirmation of the original long repeated string. Differing guesses remain unverified.'
